body.purpose: Default UI text, table cells, descriptions.

label.purpose: Badges, field hints, timestamps, column meta.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Only floating layers carry a shadow; cards and panels are flat.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and state changes; no page-load choreography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single navy action per view region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 32px field with hairline stroke and navy focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; caret-color: var(--primary); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badges
components.description: Signal colour on its own 10% tint; always with words.
components.html: Overdue Blocked Completed In progress
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-badge-critical { color: var(--destructive); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); } .ds-badge-warning { color: var(--warning); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--warning) 10%, transparent); } .ds-badge-success { color: var(--success); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--success) 10%, transparent); } .ds-badge-info { color: var(--info); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--info) 10%, transparent); }

components.name: Record Card
components.description: Flat card with hairline ring; groups a record or task.
components.html:
Northwind Aurora
Bulk carrier · IMO 9384124
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font: 500 16px/1.375 var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-card-meta { font: 400 14px/1.43 var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Console Panel navigation; active item gets the hover fill and medium weight.
components.html: DashboardVessels
components.css: .ds-nav { background: var(--sidebar); padding: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 240px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); font: 400 14px var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring); }

narrative.overview: Aegir is used the way a ship's bridge is used at night: long stretches of calm monitoring, broken by moments that demand an immediate, correct response. The interface is therefore quiet by default. Surfaces are neutral, type is a single well-tuned sans, and the only persistent colour is a deep harbour navy that marks where you can act. Everything else that lights up is a signal: a failed check, an overdue work order, a blocked task, a handover waiting for acknowledgement. Because colour is rare, a signal is impossible to miss.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral canvas; one navy accent reserved for action, selection and focus.
Colour is a signal vocabulary (critical, warning, success, info), never decoration.
One type family (Geist), fixed rem scale, tabular numerals for data.
Flat surfaces separated by hairline rings, not shadows.
Comfortable-compact density; 32px controls; mobile-first sidebar collapse.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Colour other than navy and neutrals means state. If a coloured element does not report a status, severity or risk, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Lit Instrument Rule
rules.body: Navy marks where you can act or where you are (primary action, current nav item, focus, selection). It never fills large decorative regions on Operate screens.

rules.name: The Two-Channel Rule
rules.body: Every signal also carries text (and usually an icon). Colour is never the only channel.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Any number that is compared, totalled or scanned in a column uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: No fluid (clamp) type on Operate screens; steps stay at 12/14/16/24px.

rules.name: The Quiet Hull Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once: a hairline ring or a shadow, never both on the same surface. Cards never get decorative shadows.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, text-warning) and shadcn variants; never raw palette classes.
Do pair every signal colour with text and, for severity, an icon (The Two-Channel Rule).
Do use tabular-nums for counts, dates and tonnage in tables and metrics (The Ledger Rule).
Do keep one primary (navy) action per view region.
Do show skeletons shaped like the content while data streams in.
Do compose light and dark themes deliberately; signals are re-tuned for dark, not inverted.
donts: Don't use colour as decoration: no navy hero blocks on Operate screens, no gradient text, no tinted card backgrounds (The Signal Rule).
Don't add shadows to cards or combine a ring with a shadow (The Quiet Hull Rule).
Don't use coloured border-left stripes on cards, alerts or list items.
Don't use eyebrow/kicker labels above headings, or big-number "hero metric" tiles as the dashboard's structure.
Don't use monospace for anything except technical identifiers.
Don't open a modal for a task that can be done inline; reserve dialogs for confirmation of destructive actions.
